content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps on the central harassment claim. Complainant identified 15 people and specific documents (Administrator's Audit Report, travel vouchers, field intelligence reports, requests for information) that could show the \"off the books\" investigation, but the record does not show the EEO investigator or the Agency obtained them or interviewed those witnesses. The Agency relied on an OPR Bluebook Report with only 9 interviews, all denials, and did not independently develop the evidence. The nonselection claims have no described selecting-official affidavits, comparator or selectee information, or explanation of the selection process. The dispute over whether the transfer predated EEO contact, and the \"shame you called EEO\" remark, were not shown to be investigated with the relevant witnesses. The FAD's conclusion that Complainant failed to prove discrimination therefore cannot be reliably evaluated on this record."}
